items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: wonderful to work with. We had a great time, the only great time I’ve had in Germany. That was the best time.

ctx.x: Then there’s one listed here of Annie Ross and Pony Poindexter. Coming from San Francisco, we all celebrate Pony. So if you could talk about him and this recording, please.
